snippet.title: Horror VR game: Lost Soul : Escape the Doom Museum (trailer) #vrgames #horrorgame #steam #gaming
snippet.description:
Your body is gone. Your soul remains. The museum won’t let you leave.

Trapped in a cursed museum where death is only the beginning, you are a lost soul wandering through exhibits twisted by ancient horrors. In this VR escape-horror experience, defeat doesn't mean game over — it means disembodiment.

ABOUT THIS GAME
Monsters You’ve Never Faced Before

Step into the world of Eastern horror like never before. For the first time in a VR horror game, you’ll encounter traditional Chinese zombies—relentless, eerie creatures that never stop once they’ve spotted you. Prefer something more classic? Watch out for the gargoyle’s razor-sharp teeth, or the sinister presence of voodoo spirits, demons, elves, ghosts, mummies, and more. Each monster is uniquely designed to make your skin crawl.

Death Isn’t the End

In Lost Soul: Escape the Doom Museum, you don’t die—you transform. As a disembodied soul, you’ll roam the haunted museum in search of a new host. Possess statues, artifacts, or even other beings to continue your journey. Death becomes part of the experience—just like a true ghost.

Secrets Hidden Beyond Life

Beyond the main story lies a web of hidden secrets and ghostly lore, tucked away in the shadows of the museum. Some mysteries only reveal themselves after your spirit is freed from its host. Only by dying can you unlock certain paths and hidden narratives. In this world, death might be the key to the truth.

A Living, Breathing Museum

Explore a richly detailed private museum, filled with artifacts, ancient relics, and even magical idols from across cultures and histories. As you flee from terrifying creatures, take a moment to examine the exhibits—and even read real-world books scattered throughout the halls. It's part haunted house, part immersive history tour.

Play Now — If You Dare

Dive into one of the most unique VR horror experiences yet. Possess, escape, uncover secrets, and survive the Doom Museum.

Will you break the curse… or become part of the collection?
